name: Phoenix Rebirth #83 — Ishtar, Sovereign of the Morning Star
description: She descends as both desire and conquest, crowned by the fire of Venus. In Mesopotamian myth, Ishtar rules love, war, kingship, and the dangerous brilliance of divine passion. She is beauty that can seduce and power that can devastate. In her Phoenix incarnation, dawn itself becomes a weapon of rebirth. Flame gathers at her command not as ornament, but as destiny. She rises as the Morning Star made flesh — radiant, untamed, and sovereign over both longing and battle. Where hearts awaken and empires tremble, Ishtar stands between ecstasy and ruin.
